<!--
Ambiguity that admits two conforming readings is a bug we want. File it against the
clause, not just the code. Like every substantive item, a defect is tracked as an
`rfc` issue so its resolution and rationale stay visible. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->

## Clause(s)
<!-- The exact clause ID(s), e.g. KISS-OPS-6.0-0002. -->

## What the text says
<!-- Quote the current normative text. -->

## Why it is ambiguous / self-contradictory / untestable
<!-- Be specific: which two requirements conflict, or which value/behavior is unpinned. -->

## Two conforming readings that diverge (for an interop failure)
<!-- If two implementations read the same clause and behaved differently, give both
     readings and the observable divergence (bytes, values, accept/decline). -->

## Suggested fix (optional)
<!-- A concrete edit, if you have one. Follow house style if it is normative text. -->
